_comment: What every AREA inherits. An area's own project.json overrides anything here,
so shared facts (who to contact, what identifies us to Crossref) are corrected
in one place instead of in five.
user_agent   sent to Crossref and arXiv by `make bib` and by the ingest.
Identify the tool honestly and do NOT put a personal email address
here -- it goes to third parties on every lookup.
contact_email  appears ON THE PUBLISHED PAGE. Left blank deliberately: filling
it publishes that address at hatkapina.cc. Set it if you want it.
site_dir_prefix  the path under the web root; areas land in <prefix>/<area>/.
has_roster  false: we collect published literature and write none of it, so there is no own/shared distinction and wiki/group.md is deliberately absent.
name: PaperLib
